objective: A useful noisy offline annotation baseline; no requirement of perfect or 95% repeat equality.

quality_review.method: Review complete selected trajectories against visible evidence; record clearly unsupported labels and reasons separately from defensible boundary disagreements. Review all rows, including N omissions; preserve original outputs.
quality_review.target: Aim for >=95% defensible individual rubric judgments on this reviewed sample; also report applicable judgments, affected steps and critical failure cases to expose N-label dilution.
quality_review.limits: Developer review is not independent human ground truth; selected checks, mechanical anchors, reasonable-label fraction and repeat agreement are distinct and none establish 95% population accuracy.
quality_review.release: Can recommend v5 for full offline exploratory annotation if review finds predominantly useful judgments with bounded documented errors. Recurrent severe task/effect hallucinations require fixing or narrowing intended use; isolated mistakes need not cause endless prompt revisions.

invariants: do not choose best of repeats
